Introduce precursor molecules (e.g., hydrogen cyanide, formaldehyde) and monitor for spontaneous polymerization into nucleic acid analogs or peptide-like structures. 3. **Comparative Analysis**: Compare the kinetic stability and information-carrying capacity of synthesized non-aqueous polymers against aqueous DNA/RNA controls. 4. **Statistical Falsification Test**: If no complex, heritable chemical systems are observed in >1000 independent non-aqueous trials and no biosignatures are detected in >50 distinct non-aqueous celestial targets, the null hypothesis (water is required) remains provisionally valid. If even one robust case of non-aqueous heredity is found, the hypothesis is falsified.

baselines: Aqueous Control Group: Standard PCR and ribozyme activity assays in pure water at 298 K, 1 bar.

metrics: Polymer Half-Life (t1/2): Time required for 50% degradation of synthesized macromolecules in the solvent.

Precursor Complexity Reduction: Systematically remove specific precursor molecules to identify the minimal chemical set required for non-aqueous self-assembly.
